<italic>Shib ah, the seven days of mourning for a near relative</italic>. M. Kat. 20
<sup>a</sup>, v. שְׁלֹשָׁה; a. fr.—Y. M. Kat. III, 82
<sup>c</sup>; v. שָׁמַר.—
<plural-form>Pl. שִׁבְעִים</plural-form>
<italic>seventy</italic>. Snh. V, 5 עד ש' ואחד (add to the members of the court,) until they number seventy-one. Ab. Zar. 11
<sup>b</sup> אחת לש' שנה once every seventy years; a. v. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="U00157">
<head-word>שָׁבַע</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>Nif.</italic> נִשְׁבַּע (b. h.) 
<italic>to be sworn, to swear</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Shebu. III, 6 נ' לבטל וכ' if a person swears that he will omit to perform a commandment. Ib. VI, 4 אין נִשְׁבָּעִין על וכ' no oath is imposed in refutation of a claim of a deaf and mute, or of an insane person, or of a minor, nor do we administer an oath to a (claimant) minor, אבל נשבעין לקטן וכ' but you must make oath when suing a minor or the sacred treasury. Ib. 7 ומי נ' מי … שמא יִשָּׁבַע זה וכ' which of them is first admitted to an oath? He with whom the (lost) pledge was deposited, lest this one (the debtor) swear (to the value of the pledge), and the other produce the pledge (and prove him a perjurer). Ib. VII, 1 כל הנשבעין שבתורה נשבעין וכ' all those bound to swear according to Biblical law swear and are free from payment, but the following swear and receive (are awarded their claim). Ib. 32
<sup>b</sup> ואינו יכול לִישָּׁבֵעַ, v. שְׁבוּעָה; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִשְׁבִּיעַ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to adjure; to impose, administer an oath</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. IV, 3 אמרו אין אנו … מַשְׁבִּיעַ אני עליכם וכ' if they say, we know no testimony in thy case, (and he says,) I adjure you, and they say, Amen: they are guilty (if they could testify). Ib. ה' עליהן … חוץ וכ' if he adjured them five times out of court, and coming before court they confess (that they know testimony), they are acquitted. Ib. VIII, 2 מַשְׁבִּיעֲךָ אני וכ' I adjure thee, and he says, Amen. Ib. 29
<sup>a</sup>; 39
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. וכשמַשְׁבִּיעִין אותו … אנו משביעין אותך וכ' and when the court administers an oath to him, they say to him, know that we cause thee to swear not in thy sense, but in the sense of God and in the sense of the court; a. fr.—Part. pass. מוּשְׁבָּע; 
<plural-form>pl. מוּשְׁבָּעִין</plural-form>. Ib. 31
<sup>a</sup> מ' מפי עצמו one who is sworn on his own demand (in his own case); מ' מפי אחרים one who is sworn on other people’s demands (as a supposed witness that claims ignorance). Ib. III, 6 הרשות שאינו מ' עליה מהר סיני a religiously indifferent act, on which he is not sworn from Mount Sinai; מצוה שהוא מ' וכ' a religious act on which he is sworn &c. Ib. 21
<sup>b</sup>; 22
<sup>b</sup>, v. סִינַי; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="U00158">
<head-word>שְׁבַע</head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<language-key> ch.,</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>Ithpa.</italic> אִשְׁתַּבַּע, 
<italic>Ithpe.</italic> אִשְׁתְּבַע, אִישְּׁבַע as preced. 
<italic>Nif.</italic> Targ. Lev. V, 22; 24.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Jer. V, 2; a. fr.—
<pgbrk id="pg1516" />Shebu. 29
<sup>a</sup> ודילמא … וכי קא מִשְׁתַּבַּע אדעתא דיריה א' perhaps that man saw a huge bird and called it 
<italic>gamla</italic> (camel), and when he swore (that he saw a camel fly in the air), he swore in his sense. Ib. דכי קא משתבע … קא משתבע so that when he swears (that he has paid the money), he swears to the truth in his sense (having given him tokens, v. אִיסְקוּנְדְּרֵי). Ib. 32
<sup>b</sup> אי … הוה מִשְׁתַּבַּעְנָא וכ if thou hadst come and testified for me, I should have been assigned an oath and received my claim; מי יימר דמִשְׁתַּבְּעַת who can say that thou wouldst have made oath? Ib. לִישְׁתַּבַּע shall he be admitted to an oath? Ib. 26
<sup>a</sup> ואנא בשיקרא אִישְׁתַּבְּעִי and have I sworn falsely?; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Af.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אַשְׁבַּע</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> as preced. 
<italic>Hif.</italic> Targ. Y. II Ex. XIII, 19 [read:] מִשְׁבָּע אַשְׁבַּע.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Cant. II, 7. Targ. Cant. II, 4; a. e.—Shebu. 36
<sup>a</sup> אַשְׁבְּעִינְהוּ ולייטינהו he made them swear, and also pronounced a curse upon them. Ib. 41
<sup>a</sup> לא מַשְׁבְּעִינָן ליה we do not put him to an oath; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="U00159">
<head-word>שָׂבֵעַ</head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> next w.) 
<italic>sated, filled, satisfied</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gitt. 56
<sup>a</sup> יוצא כשהוא ש', v. רָעֵב I. Lev. R. s. 34 לשְׂבֵעוֹ וכ', v. רָעֵב I; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. שְׂבֵעִים, שְׂבֵעִין, שְׂבֵי'</plural-form>. Joma 74
<sup>b</sup> סומין … ואינו ש' blind persons eat and are not satisfied. Taan. 10
<sup>b</sup> אל תראו עצמיכם בפני בני עשו … כאילו אתם ש' Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) make no show of your plenty before the sons of Esau or of Ishmael, lest they envy you; Yalk. Gen. 148; a. e.—
<italic>Fem.</italic> שְׂבֵעָה, שְׂבֵי'. Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42
<sup>c</sup> top the Lord allows the righteous in this world to see their (future) reward, ונפשם ש' וכ' and they feel satisfied and go to sleep; a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. שְׂבֵעוֹת, שְׂבֵי'</plural-form>. Midr. Sam. ch. XIII (ref. to I Sam. IX, 12, sq.) וכל האורך הזה … ולא היו ש' ממנו why this lengthy speech? It intimates that they looked at the beauty of Saul and could not see enough of it; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<binyan-form>הִשְׂבִּיעַ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to satisfy</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 76, end כדי להַשְׂבִּיעַ עיניו וכ' in order to satisfy the eyes of the wicked man. Y. Keth. V, 30
<sup>b</sup> הִשְׂבִּיעָתוֹ; Succ. l. c. מַשְׂבִּיעוֹ, v. רָעֵב II. Snh. 100
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—Ib. 29
<sup>b</sup> אדם עשוי שלא להשביע את עצמו man is wont not to declare himself wealthy (to disclaim wealth, by saying that he is in debt, even if he is not); כשם שאדם … שלא להשביע את בניו as man is wont to disclaim wealth for himself, so is he likely to disclaim it for his heirs (therefore an ante-mortem confession of indebtedness does not establish a claim against heirs).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<binyan-form>שִׂבֵּעַ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> same.—Part. pass. מְשׂוּבָּע. Lev. R. s. 29 (play on השביעי, Lev. XXIII, 24) שהוא מש' בכל וכ' a month which is plentiful in every thing &c.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִשְׂתַּבֵּעַ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be satiated, sick</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Num. R. s. 14 עתיד להִשְׂתַּבּעַ, v. סִיג I.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<notes> Targ. O. Ex. XVI, 8 למִיסְבַּע ed. Berl. (ed. Amst. למִישְׂ'); Y. למִשְׂבּוֹעַ. Targ. Ps. CIV, 16 (Ms. ס'); a. fr.—Part. שְׂבִיעַ, שְׂבַע, סְ'; f. שָׂבְעָא, סָ'. Targ. Prov. XXX, 22 דשביע ed. Lag. (Ms. דסביע; ed. Wil. דיִשְׂבַּע). Targ. Job XLII, 17. Targ. Gen. XXV, 8. Targ. Prov. XXVII, 7; a. fr.—Pesik. R. s. 16; Pesik. Eth Korb., p. 57

<italic>to satisfy</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ps. XC, 14. Ib. CVII, 9; a. fr.—Taan. 24
<sup>a</sup> רחמנא לִישַׂבְּעָךְ … דאַשְׂבְּעָן ברך the Lord satisfy thee, as thy son has satisfied us. Yoma 79
<sup>b</sup> שַׂבּוּעֵי מְשַׂבְּעא is enough to satisfy the appetite. Gitt. 70
<sup>a</sup> תמרי מְשַׂבְּעַן וכ' dates satisfy, heat &c.; Keth. 10
<sup>b</sup>; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<entry id="U00169">
<head-word>שְׁבַק</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (corresp. to h. עָזַב) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to leave, let go; to forsake, abandon; to leave behind; to bequeath</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Jer. LI, 9. Targ. Ex. XXIII, 5. Targ. Jud. XVI, 26 (h. text הניחה); a. v. fr.—Part. pass. שְׁבִיק; f. שְׁבִיקָא, שְׁבִיקְתָּא; 
<plural-form>pl. שְׁבִיקִין; שְׁבִיקָתָא, שְׁבִיקָן</plural-form>. Targ. Jer. LI, 5 (h. text אלמן). Targ. Ez. XXXVI, 4. Ib. XLI, 9; 11 (h. text מֻנָּח); a. fr.—Y. Nidd. II, end, 50
<sup>b</sup> אמר שׁוֹבְקְתֵיה לצפרא he said (to the woman), leave it (with me) for the morning. Sabb. 32
<sup>a</sup> שַׁבְקֵיה וכ', v. רַוְיָא. Yoma 12
<sup>a</sup> למִישְׁבַּק, v. אוּשְׁפִּיזָא. Arakh. 22
<sup>a</sup> מי שַׁבְקִינָן מזוני וכ' shall we leave the alimony (which the widow receives out of the estate, as long as her dowry is not satisfied) unguarded? Ib. מי שבקינן ליה do we allow him (to take interest)? B. Bath. 125
<sup>a</sup> לאו הני מעות ש' אבוהון it is not these coins that their father left them (when he died). Gitt. 37
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. (לא שבק) לא שָׁבֵיק (אינש) וכ', v. הֶיתֵּרָא. Bekh. 24
<sup>a</sup> במקום דידה לא שַׁבְקָה דידה וכ' when the dam has her own child, she will not neglect her own and give suck to a strange animal. B. Mets. 92
<sup>a</sup> לא ש' איסי חיי וכ' Isi would let no man live, i.e. with such a law humanity could not exist; B. Kam. 91
<sup>b</sup> א"כ לא שַׁבְקַת חיי וכ' if this were the law, thou wouldst let no creature exist; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to remit, pardon, forgive</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Gen. XVIII, 24. Targ. Num. XIV, 19; a. fr.—Lev. R. s. 5, end יאי … דשָׁבֵיק לחובין וכ' it is becoming the great God to remit great sins; a. e.—Part. pass. as ab. Ib. הא שרי לך והא שביק לך this is remitted to thee, and this is forgiven thee; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to let go, send away, divorce</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 17 שְׁבוֹקָא ההיא אנתתא מינך וכ' send that woman away, for she does thee no honor; ib. שַׁבְקָהּ להדא וכ' send that bad woman away; 
<pgbrk id="pg1517" />ib. לית בידי מה אֶשְׁבּוֹק לה I have not the means to divorce her (to give her her dowry); ib. לית בי מה אשבוק לה; Lev. R. s. 34 לית בי מִשְׁבַּק לה; (Yalk. Is. 352 לית לי ממרקא לה, v. מְרַק); Y. Keth. XI, 34
<sup>b</sup> bot. שיבקה דלית וכ' (read: שׁוֹבְקָהּ or שׁבְּקָהּ 
<italic>Pa.</italic>) send her away &c.; a. e.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>שַׁבֵּק, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Af.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אַשְׁבֵּיק</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>

<sup>b</sup> נטל את הטבלא … ושְׁבָרָהּ he took the plate … and shattered it. Ex. R. s. 18 (ref. to Ps. IX, 1 כונסה … והיא שׁוֹבֶרֶת לו וכ' he marries her and divorces her (and remarries her), and she gives him a receipt for her jointure (by which act the mortgage on the entire estate is cancelled); Y. ib. VIII, 32
<sup>b</sup> bot.; Y. Yeb. IV, 5
<sup>d</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>

<sup>b</sup> אחד משגרו וכ' he sent out one (serpent) to the south &c. B. Bath. 146
<sup>a</sup>. Sot. 35
<sup>b</sup> שִׁגְּרוּ וכ', v. נוֹטָרִין a. fr.—Part. pass. מְשׁוּגָּר; f. מְשׁוּגֶּרֶת. Cant. R. to IV, 1, v. רוֹגְלִית; ib. to I, 15 שוגרת corr. acc.).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<entry id="U00299">

<xref rid="A00083">שאה)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to stand still, pause; to dwell, tarry</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Shebu. II, 3 או שש' בכדי השתחוואה or if the unclean person stayed in the Temple long enough for prostration. Ib. 17
<sup>a</sup> (mixed dict.) בדלא ש' when he did not stand still (but walked constantly though slowly). Yeb. VI, 7 נשא אשה וש' עמה וכ' if one married a woman and lived with her ten years without issue. Ib. רשאי השני 
<pgbrk id="pg1527" /> לִשְׁהוֹת וכ'the second husband may live with her ten years. Ib. 36
<sup>b</sup> כל ששהא וכ' a human birth that survived thirty days (although born in the eighth month) is not considered an abortion; Sabb. 135
<sup>b</sup> ששהה. Ber. V, 1 חסידים … שׁוֹהִין שעה וכ' the pious men of olden times used to tarry a while (in the synagogue) before prayer &c. Ib. 32
<sup>b</sup> היו שוהין שעה … וחוזרין ושוהין וכ' they waited an hour, and prayed an hour, and tarried again an hour (at synagogue); a. fr.—Esp. (ritual) 
<italic>to pause during the act of slaughtering</italic> (which makes the animal so cut unfit to eat). Ḥull. 2
<sup>b</sup> שמא יִשְׁהוּ וכ' they might pause, might press the knife &c., v. שְׁהִיָּיה. Ib. 12
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to delay</italic>, v. infra.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses>

<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>

<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to cause delay; to detain, restrain</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Nidd. 31
<sup>a</sup> sq. מהוך שמַשְׁהִין עצמן וכ' because they restrain themselves (retard effusion) &c. Snh. 76
<sup>a</sup> המַשְׁהֶא בתו וכ' he who retards (the marriage of) his marriageable daughter. Gen. R. s. 85 והן מַשְׁהִין אותן וכ' and they (the sons of Eli) caused them to stay away from their home one night. Lev. R. s. 37, beg. שנודר ומשהה וכ' who vows (a sacrifice) and procrastinates the fulfilment of his vow. Ib. ע"י שנדר ושָׁהָה את נדרו (perh. שִׁהָה, 
<italic>Pi.</italic>) because he had vowed and was procrastinating &c. Keth. 61
<sup>a</sup> הכל משהין בפני השמש וכ' you may postpone every dish before the waiter (keep him from eating while he is serving), except &c.; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<sup>c</sup> top אסור לְשָׁהוֹתוֹ ואם שִׁיהוֹ וכ' (or לַשְׁהוֹתוֹ, 
<italic>Hif.</italic>) you must not let it stand, but if one did, and it turned into vinegar &c. Ib. ואם שִׁיהָן and if one did let them stand; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<binyan-form>הִשְׁתָּהֶה, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִשְׁתָּהֶא, נִשְׁתָּהֶה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be delayed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> R. Hash. IV, 4 פעם אחת נִשְׁתָּהוּ … מלבוא once the witnesses (that had seen the new moon rise) were delayed from coming (were late). Nidd. 27
<sup>a</sup> מעשה ונ' הולד אחר וכ' it occurred that a twin child was born three months after its brother; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> v. 
<xref rid="U00296">שָׁהָה</xref>) [
<italic>vacancy</italic>,] 
<italic>vanity, inanity, falsehood</italic>.</definition>
<notes> שבועת ש' a false oath, vowing to do something impossible, opp. בִּיטּוּי. Shebu. III, 9 שבועה שאוכל … והשנייה שבועת ש' (if one says) ‘I swear that I will eat this loaf, (and) I swear that I will not eat it’, the former is a useless oath (or vow), the second a false oath; אכלה עבר על שבועת ש' וכ' if he eats it, he is guilty of a false oath (having sworn that he would not eat it); if he does not eat it, he is (also) guilty of a useless oath. Ib. 8 איזוהי שבועת ש' נשבע וכ' what is a vain oath of affirmation? If one swears to that which is known to be otherwise, saying of a stone column that it is gold &c.; נשבע … שאי אפשר וכ' if one affirms an impossibility, saying I swear that I have seen a camel fly in the air. Ib. נשבע לבטל … זו היא שבועת ש' וכ' if he swears that he will neglect a command, that he will not erect a Succah, …: that is a vain oath, on the wilful pronouncing of which he is punished with stripes &c. Ib. 21
<sup>a</sup> איזוהי שבועת ש' … שקר נשבע וכ' what is a vain oath? If one swears to what is known to be otherwise; a false oath, if one swears to the opposite of the truth (e.g. ‘I have eaten’, when he has not, ‘I have not eaten’, when he has), v. שֶׁקֶר. Ib. 20
<sup>b</sup> ש' ושקר אחד הן a vain oath (
<italic>shav</italic>) and a false oath (
<italic>sheḳer</italic>) are the same; a. fr.—תפלת ש' a vain prayer, a prayer concerning a thing which cannot be changed. Ber. IX, 3; a. fr.—Ex. R. s. 3 (ref. to מתי שוא, Job XI, 1</notes></sense>

<number>1)</number>

<pgbrk id="pg1528" />(idolatry) to commit it; העתידים לעשות ש' וכ' those that will commit falsehood and be put to death.</definition>
<notes>—לַשָּׁ' in 
<italic>vain, to no purpose</italic>. Keth. 62
<sup>b</sup>, v. שָׁמַר. Y. Meg. III, 74
<sup>a</sup> bot., v. תַּמְרוּרִים.</notes></sense></senses></entry>
